title: Comparing predictive values across priors
description: You can hold test parameters fixed while changing the model's base rate.

steps.description: ppv computes positive predictive value and npv computes negative predictive value. You use pi for the prior and Se and Sp for sensitivity and specificity.
The loop visits priors 0.01, 0.1 and 0.5. Both test parameters remain fixed at 0.95.

steps.question: Does fixed sensitivity and specificity give the same PPV for every supplied prior?
steps.answer: No. The recorded PPV values change from 0.161 to 0.679 to 0.950.

steps.description: You see both predictive values reach 0.950 at prior 0.50. At prior 0.01, the model instead prints PPV 0.161 and NPV 0.999.
